specId.fullTitle: Fire Safety Design Review - Use case

authoring.copyright: Copyright 2026 Building Informatics Group (BIG), Yonsei University. Sample for testing; not normative.

description.title: The architect delivers a fire safety design model so that the fire safety engineer and the permit authority can check fire compartmentation, fire resistance of compartment boundaries and egress travel distances.
Aim: replace drawing-based fire plan review with model-based checking during design development.
Scope: spaces, fire compartments, compartment boundaries, fire doors and egress paths. Smoke control and suppression system design are out of scope.
Fire safety design model approved for building permit submission.
Fire compartment and egress information as defined in the exchange requirement.

businessRule.name: Fire compartment assignment
businessRule.statement: Every space shall be assigned to exactly one fire compartment.

description.title: Commentary: shafts and stair enclosures form their own compartments.

businessRule.name: Fire compartment area limit
businessRule.statement: The floor area of a fire compartment shall not exceed 1,000 m2, or 3,000 m2 where an automatic sprinkler system is installed.

image.caption: Fire compartment plan with floor areas

description.title: Commentary: the limit applies per storey; check the decree for exemptions by use.

businessRule.reference: Enforcement Decree of the Building Act (Republic of Korea), Art. 46 (illustrative)

businessRule.name: Fire resistance of compartment boundaries
businessRule.statement: Walls and slabs that bound a fire compartment shall have a fire resistance of at least 1 hour.

businessRule.name: Fire doors in compartment boundaries
businessRule.statement: Every door in a fire compartment boundary shall be a self-closing fire door.

businessRule.name: Travel distance to direct stair
businessRule.statement: The walking distance from any point in a habitable room to the nearest direct stair shall not exceed 30 m, or 50 m where the main structural parts are fire-resistant.

description.title: Commentary: measured along the actual walking path, not as a straight line.

businessRule.reference: Enforcement Decree of the Building Act (Republic of Korea), Art. 34 (illustrative)

businessRule.name: Exit door clear width
businessRule.statement: The clear width of every exit door on an egress path shall be at least 0.9 m.

businessRule.name: Traceable non-conformities
businessRule.statement: Every non-conformity in the fire safety review report shall identify the violated business rule and the affected building element.

description.title: Commentary: non-conformities are exchanged as BCF topics so that the architect can locate them in the model.
Earlier detection of fire safety non-compliance; fewer permit resubmissions.
Travel distance requires a computed egress path, which not all authoring tools export.
IFC 4.3 export from the design authoring tool; a rule-checking tool.
Modelling of spaces and zones; knowledge of fire safety regulations.
